summary: Dropped derived context_pack/context_chunk documents from the search corpus. buildSearchEntries now indexes only primary records, readSearchSnapshot no longer loads or synthesizes context packs, context search queries primary records, and handoff search no longer special-cases context chunks. Dogfood search-index.json rebuilt from 46M to 14M with 1308 documents and no context document types.
command: env COREPACK_HOME=/private/tmp/corepack pnpm check && env COREPACK_HOME=/private/tmp/corepack pnpm test && env COREPACK_HOME=/private/tmp/corepack pnpm --silent bwrk sync refresh --json >/tmp/boreal-sync-refresh-t2.json && /usr/bin/time -p env COREPACK_HOME=/private/tmp/corepack pnpm --silent bwrk sync status --json >/tmp/boreal-sync-status-final-t2.json && env COREPACK_HOME=/private/tmp/corepack pnpm --silent bwrk doctor --strict --json >/tmp/boreal-doctor-strict-t2.json && git diff --check
